title: Rubio: things flying over nuclear sites

tellings.quote: Marco Rubio, our Secretary of State, basically admits that we know somebody said, "What's the conspiracy you believe in most?" He goes, "There are things flying with impunity around our nuclear sites."

plain: Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, is said to have been asked which conspiracy he believes in most and to have answered, "There are things flying with impunity around our nuclear sites." Michels relays the exchange himself, taking it as close to an admission from a top official that unknown objects fly freely over America's nuclear facilities.
